system.description:
The O.M.G.A. trains illusionists to serve Opal as spies, interrogators and propagandists.

  • Perfect Impersonation: Advantage on Disguise checks to impersonate a specific person. A creature that fails a Will save against your spell takes −2 on its next Will save against you this encounter.
  • State Authority: Advantage on Persuasion invoking O.M.G.A. authority, and on long-term social infiltration.
